```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Republican bill eliminates the individual mandate, which will likely cause the market for individual coverage to collapse.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican plan allows younger, healthy individuals to opt out of the insurance market.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican plan maintains the ban on insurers rejecting people for pre-existing conditions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Under the Republican bill, uninsured individuals who sign up for insurance after a serious health care setback will pay a 30 percent penalty on their insurance for the first year, with the penalty going to the insurance company.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Many younger individuals will take the risk and not pay for insurance.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican bill allows insurers to charge older individuals five times the insurance premiums of younger individuals.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The ACA limited the difference in insurance premiums between older and younger individuals to three times.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Planned Parenthood will be barred from receiving Medicaid reimbursements for a year.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Planned Parenthood will not be eligible for Medicaid funding if they perform abortions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Barring Planned Parenthood from Medicaid reimbursements and funding will severely limit low and moderate income women’s access to reproductive services.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA recognizes weaknesses in the ACA.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA has consistently campaigned for a single-payer Medicare for All health care system.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The ACA’s subsidies were not generous enough to enable moderate income individuals to avoid plans with excessively high deductibles.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The ACA’s subsidies failed to guarantee equal quality health care provision.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
